title: InputRouter now calls directly into FlowView; the SELECT branch of the positional grammar lives outside the pinned static classify()
evidence:
## THE rule: a node hit draws, a pipe hit selects, anything else orbits.
static func classify(collider: Object) -> Mode:
	if collider is NodeSite:
		return Mode.DRAW
	return Mode.ORBIT
...
	_picked_pipe = flow_view.pick_pipe(screen_pos, camera)
	_mode = Mode.SELECT if _picked_pipe >= 0 else Mode.ORBIT
detail: The input layer now holds a direct dependency on a view node, and the SELECT decision cannot be headlessly pinned the way the header claims classify() pins the contract.
recommended_fix: Inject the pipe pick via main (composition root) — e.g. a picker callable set at wiring time — so InputRouter stays view-free and the full grammar stays testable.

title: Capture harness reaches into main's private signal handlers and untyped sim instead of the public path
detail: Underscore-prefixed handlers are private by the codebase's own convention; the harness bypasses the wired signals (router.pipe_selected / qos_panel.apply_requested). Renames break captures at runtime.
recommended_fix: Expose public open_qos(pipe_id)/apply_qos(...) on main (or emit the existing public signals) and have the capture harness use those.

title: FlowView.pulse_egress maps sim node index to Nodes-container child position — a cross-module invariant held only by staging order
detail: Sim index == child index is maintained by main._stage_nodes and consumed here positionally; inserting any non-site child into Nodes silently drops or shifts pulses (guard turns breakage into wrong behavior).
recommended_fix: Build a node_index -> NodeSite map once in setup() (or have main pass sites) and look nodes up by index instead of get_child(i).

title: 17-command replay topology duplicated byte-for-byte between tools/determinism_log.gd and tests/test_sim_replay.gd, kept in sync by comment only
evidence:
## Aligned byte-for-byte with tests/test_sim_replay.gd CMDS — the committed
## capture and its sibling test exercise the SAME topology.
const CMDS := [
	{"cmd": "add_pipe", "a": 1, "b": 0},
detail: Two hand-maintained copies of the same fixture (verified identical today: tests/test_sim_replay.gd declares the same CMDS). Drift would silently decouple the committed capture from the tested topology.
recommended_fix: Extract the command list into one shared const (e.g. a static fixture on SimBalance or a fixtures script) and reference it from both files.

title: PipeArc.build_legacy compat shim has one caller and is behaviorally identical to build(a, b, 1.0)
detail: The shim's only parameter is discarded and its single call site (_show_preview in connect_controller.gd:108) could call build(a, b, 1.0) for the identical result — dead compatibility layer.
recommended_fix: Change connect_controller._show_preview to _preview.build(a, b, 1.0) and delete build_legacy.

title: Editor-only capture routine (viewport camera mutation, force_draw, PNG save, quit) embedded in the runtime composition root
detail: About 45 lines of editor harness tooling now live in main.gd alongside runtime wiring. The @tool guards are correct, but the root keeps accreting editor concerns beyond the inspector button.
recommended_fix: Move the --editor-preview-shot path into an editor-side tool script that loads the scene and invokes main's _regenerate_preview, keeping main runtime-focused.

title: QosPanel._sim member is assigned in open() and never read
evidence:
var _sim: SimCore
...
	_pipe_id = pipe_id
	_sim = sim
	var p: Dictionary = sim.pipes.get(pipe_id)
detail: The cached SimCore reference is write-only (grep confirms _sim appears only at declaration line 14 and assignment line 116); open() already reads its parameter locally.
recommended_fix: Delete the _sim member and its assignment.
